capabilities: Display PDF pages alongside editable Markdown notes in two- or three-column layouts
Link notes to physical PDF page numbers via wikilinks and HTML comment markers
Zoom, pan, and copy text from PDF pages
Open and pick PDFs from vault folders
Export slides and notes using Obsidian's Export to PDF
extras: Install is manual from GitHub release files; targets desktop Obsidian 1.12.7 or later; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; scanned PDFs are shown without OCR; no accounts, network services, or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian lacks a built-in way to read a PDF and take page-linked Markdown notes side by side in Live Preview.

relations.evidence: Bundled PDF.js code is available under Apache-2.0.

summary: PDF reader that shows PDF pages beside editable Markdown notes linked to specific pages in Obsidian Live Preview.
